tasks.title: Qualify crashes, split merge, wake and zero-quorum recovery

steps.action: Run the full native history oracle over interleaved cells, both image modes and all new durable cuts. Include deterministic exhaustive transition/park event schedules and process SIGKILL at persistence boundaries; finite tests complement rather than prove the protocol.

Run real RustFS campaigns with physical log reclamation, S3 outage, slow apply/minority, leader/controller restart and every split/merge cut. Verify per-cell values, versions, receipts, effect IDs and no two writable owners.

Delete all owned voter disks in standalone and in-transition scenarios after fencing; verify new incarnations, old-host restart rejection, every selected-cut cell and retained restart. Record quorum-only suffix loss separately from S3-protected effects.

Run candidate density, mixed/skew, transition, hibernation, independent-domain and 24-hour profiles. Compare identical logical-cell populations and retain misses. Do not declare a physical tier from containers on one host.

tasks.title: Publish the unified group runtime and qualified release envelope

steps.action: Audit every production registration, scope codec, image marker, archive, SDK and operator path for the old cell-equals-group assumption. Remove temporary staging adapters and legacy runtime choices; leave explicit one-cell occupancy on the common code.

Update public docs, examples, CLI/admin error messages and operator runbooks for group placement, split/merge, park/wake and fenced S3 recovery. Document fresh-root cutover and rollback limits without deleting existing state.

Run the complete workspace/feature-off/native/Axum regression matrix and all new task tests at the same immutable release source. Repeat deployment gates at that source; evidence from different revisions cannot be added into one release pass.

Publish source/artifact/profile hashes, exact supported topology/load envelope and every limitation. plan.py release must refuse until all tasks, invariant cases and mandatory profile reports pass with retained evidence.
